name: Patrick Scott
description: Atlanta-based live performer. Genre-bending covers built live with a loop pedal. Bars, breweries, festivals, weddings, private events.
_comment_sections: Home page sections that can be switched off while their content is still placeholder. Flip to true to bring them back; the data files stay in src/data/ either way.
_comment_booking_form: The booking form uses Netlify Forms - no config needed here. Submissions appear in Netlify under Forms > booking. Set up email notifications there (Forms > booking > Settings > Form notifications).
_comment_venmo: Venmo handle, no @ sign. The tip QR code is generated from this at build time.
_comment_paypal: Optional PayPal.me handle, no @ sign. Set to null to hide the PayPal button in the tip dialog.
_comment_newsletter: The email signup uses Netlify Forms - no config needed here. Addresses collect under Forms > newsletter in Netlify; export as CSV to mail the list.
